title: Weekly digest
summary: A short written summary of the last 7 days, made when you ask for it.

blocks.text: Select **Generate this week's digest** on Home. You get a summary of the last 7 days: sales against last week, the top reorder needs, dead stock, vendor savings, the biggest reconciliation gaps and barcode problems.

items: Every number comes from the same reports you see elsewhere. The AI only writes the short sentence for each part. It is never asked to work out a figure.
It is made only when you ask, and shown only here. Nothing is emailed or sent.
It needs the AI key on [Integrations](page:integrations).
With Hide sales numbers, the sales part is left out.
